name: PT Indopoly Swakarsa Industry Tbk
summary: PT Indopoly Swakarsa Industry Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a flexible-packaging manufacturing company in Indonesia, China, Singapore, and the United States. It offers plain, heatsealable, matte, white, metallized, and thermal films, as well as other specialty products. The company also manufactures biaxially oriented polypropylene films. In addition, it engages in the investment business. The company serves food and beverage, household and personal care, cigarette, label, graphic, industrial, and other industries. PT Indopoly Swakarsa Industry Tbk was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
